ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, given the functions $y=ax+b$ and $y=kx$ intersect at point $P$, according to the graph, what is the solution to the system of linear equations $\begin{cases}y=ax+b,\\ y=kx?\end{cases}$
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since the intersection point P of the graphs of the functions $y=ax+b$ and $y=kx$ is at ($-2$, $-1$), \\
therefore, the solution to the system of linear equations $\begin{cases}y=ax+b\\ y=kx\end{cases}$ is $\boxed{\begin{cases}x=-2\\ y=-1\end{cases}}$.
